newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African govt revises sept financing figures.
newsitem.headline: S.African govt revises sept financing figures.

text.p: The South African Finance Department said on Wednesday it had revised financing figures for September first released earlier in the day.
It said an original statement showing total financing in the month at 3.213 billion rand incorrectly included a foreign loan amounting to 1.491 billion rand.
The proceeds of the Euromark loan, raised by South Africa in September, were only received on October 1.
As a result total financing in the month amounted to 1.722 billion rand.
Some 3.029 billion rand was obtained in government stock, while short-term loans (net) decreased by 1.307 billion rand.
Total financing from April to September amounted to 21.951 billion rand. Budgeted financing for the year is 45.105 billion rand. This figure includes foreign loans of 2.5 billion rand.
The department said government bonds and debentures to the amount of 8.555 billion rand were redeemed during April to September 1996.
